### Changed
- The store summary and description now name Nebula and Floatplane and say "and more" for the rest, instead of listing every platform. The Chrome Web Store asked for this. Detour still works with all six platforms (Nebula, Floatplane, ClockwiseTV, 2nd try, WatcherTV and Beacon), and nothing in the extension itself has changed.

Nothing else has changed since [0.8.1](https://github.com/josh345rtfvqw/detour/releases/tag/v0.8.1).

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/detour-nebula-floatplane/), or load the zip below.
